notes.title: Great Autumn Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/0272ef1cb81deb80a339f108d704d1dacb87ebb9.jpg[/img]
The great autumn update is now released! Never before there has been so much new content in one update. Let's have a closer look what this update has to offer. Also the game has undergone a complete overhaul on the technical side, which makes it possible to add new content also in the future. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/534cc7e9d517a03f69f763f0a6ef58b60f37fb42.jpg[/img]
Two new maps are introduced. The first one is a location around a spectacular dam region in the middle of an awe inspiring mountain scenery. In this map you can go fishing either on the higher area behind the dam, or to the lower part of the map. Especially in the lower part there are good spots to find schools of many species lurking in more peaceful spots of the river. 

The second map takes us to completely new scenery. In Rice Terraces you can do fishing in small ponds in the middle of beautiful hills that are covered with rice terraces. There are also some fish living in the numeorus small rice fields that makes fishing even more interesting. In the middle of the map there is a small, but deep pond that gathers all the water flowing down from the terraces. This is also where all the largest fish in the map will live.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/88848617e076d59406d5800c37ffb566a25754e4.jpg[/img]
Next up we have three new fish species. We are happy to announce that two of the new species are also the two of the most requested fish by our community, walleye and muskellunge. These are both close relatives to zander and pike that are both familiar for the players of Ice Lakes. However, the newcomers are bigger and tougher than their relatives! Especially trying to catch muskellunge will be a challenge, because it is a huge beast leaving the northern pike to second place.

The third new fish is a beautiful newcomer. Chinese perch is a familiar fish from many Chinese books and poems and with this update it becomes a familiar fish also for all Ice Lakes players. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/ca308744bad79ce7cd0ac66410ba00d6d722c8a0.jpg[/img]
During the last two years we have implemented a lot of new fish species, but not that many new jigs into the game. This is now fixed since there will be 25 new jigs, 10 new lures, 5 new baits and 5 new hooks. These are very good for catching all the new species in the game, but there are also really good ones for the older species as well. Check all the new items in the Equipment section of the game.

notes.title: Ice Lakes - Summer Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/7ba2a5882c8959ba95192a6c5e549a0688b7da32.png[/img]

The midsommer festivities are about to start so it is a great time to talk about the next update, which is coming soon! notes.title: Ice Lakes - January Update
notes.notes:
This update adds several online features into the game that we think are valuable additions for the Ice lakes community. 

[h1]Top 3 News Feed[/h1]
In the main menu you can now see the top 3 records of the day and the top 3 of the month. In the main menu there is a news feed that tells the weight, species and the player who has caught the three of the biggest fish. 

[h1]Invite Friends[/h1]
Now you can invite your friends into your online games using Steam's own invite player functionality. Just open the Steam friends list and invite one of your friends into the game. After accepting the invite the game starts and automatically joins the server. Remember that ports are still required to be open for the host router.

[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed missing items/money bug. Now items or coins should not get lost.
    [*]Updated Russian localization to improved version.
    [*]Server Browser is limited to show only servers using the same version of the game.
[/list]

This was a smaller update, but new big things are coming. In the future updates there are a ton of new cool things we will be adding. This means all sorts of new jigs, baits, lures as well as new maps and new fish species. Also the character customization will go through a complete overhaul so that everyone can customize their own character in completely new ways. Soon is also a time for the Lunar New Year, which will be celebrated in the game. 
Finally, we have ideas of a completely new game mode that would really change the way how the game is played. More information about these in the coming months. Until then, keep on fishing!

Today we see a dragon rising when the new China update rolls out with tons of new content and localizations.

Koi fish are very rare and can be caught only from the new maps, so catching Koi is a treat for those up to the challenge.

notes.title: Ice Lakes Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/5de735304f863fe746fca0ec147e28c008a432fe.jpg[/img]

The Anniversary Update is finally out! This time we wanted to do something crazy. It is a birthday update after all ;)

Let's check out what the latest update has to offer.

[h1]Two New Maps[/h1]
[b]Tropical Freeze[/b] is the first new map. In this map players are thrown into sunny paradise islands where, because of drastic climate change phenomenon, a sudden cold atmosphere has frozen all waters. The fishermen around the world are gathering to experience ice fishing in the tropical paradise. This might be a once in a lifetime opportunity to go ice fishing in the middle of calmly waving palm trees.

[b]Polar Storm[/b], on the other hand, is from the other end of the spectrum. This map is located to polar region, where the bravest fishermen are exercising their passion on small ice rafts. There might be occasional nuclear submarine you might encounter as well.

[h1]New Fish[/h1]
[b]Barracuda[/b] is the new beast that can be caught in the waters of Ice Lakes. More precisely this is a special species that can be only found in the waters of the two new maps. Barracudas are fierce predators and they can be found almost from all depths. This will also take the position of the biggest fish that can be caught in the game.

[h1]Night-Time Fishing[/h1]
Welcome to the dark side! Night has come to Ice Lakes. This is a completely new mode you can select from the map selection menu. Night mode is a "hard" difficulty setting. This means that in general it is harder to catch fish at nighttime. However, some species are more active during night, like burbot for example.

[h1]Other[/h1]
In addition to new content there are also a ton of improvements to the base game. We added the ability to toggle the fishing rod by pressing 'g' key on your keyboard. This way it is no more necessary to hold the mouse button pressed when moving the rod.
 
Couple of bugs we received feedback are also fixed. The possibility to sell your fish in endless loop in multiplayer is now fixed, as well as the bug when detecting Rift system while starting the VR version on Oculus. 

Thanks to the power of our community, we also added Korean to localized languages. 

Finally we have started updating all of the sound effects in the game. The first new sounds are already in this update and more will follow in the upcoming updates.

notes.title: Ice Lakes Fish Fight Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/623fb4cfe2cc4d7fc71a29ef2f0ba7548165bdfe.jpg[/img]
More content, improved VR features, fish fights and more. This update has so many new things and improvements to the game that it is safe to say this being the biggest update ever. Without further due let's go through all the things it has to offer.

[b][h1]FISH FIGHTS[/h1][/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/e877898bc0cc4dfa8f904eb6203ad98576de218a.jpg[/img]
Fish fight is one of the biggest game mechanical additions to the game since the release. First of all, this is an optional feature, which can be turned on or off from the map selection screen before every game. This applies for both single and multiplayer. In multiplayer game host can turn on fish fights similarly to all other map settings before every game. Fish fights also works both, with desktop and VR versions.

Playing the fish is simple. A separate fish fighting mode is activated after fish takes a bait. However, also the size of the fish and the rod type affects if the fish fight is activated. The smallest fish do not require playing so every fish does not activate the fish fight. The important thing is not to let the line tension rise too high or let the line get too loose. While playing the fish the tension meter should be kept approximately at the center (green region). If the tension goes too up or too low, the fish will get away or the line will break. This is adjusted by reeling and pulling the rod, or letting the line loose. 

While playing on VR you need to make countermoves with your controller when the game tells to do so. The fish will get away, if you wait too long without making a countermove.

[b][h1]IMPROVED VR[/h1][/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/e84764e5d5be7c426cdff062f15f79f5231767ad.jpg[/img]
In addition to the new fish fight feature there are many new visual and game mechanical changes to VR version. 

First of all fishing scenes have now a changing scenery on the horizon. So in the middle of the fog there are also some objects and not just a foggy horizon to look at. Secondly, we added interactivity by placing a bucket into the fishing scene. All fish can be thrown into the bucket which is pretty fun when trying to fit too many big fish into one small bucket. There is also a fishing stool, which really has no real function other than just be there to make the scene look pretty and give an impression of sitting on something if playing seated :)

There are also a few more serious game mechanical changes to VR. There were the fish fight features, but also the slush scoop is now used manually while playing on VR. Also the drilling can be done manually by grapping the handles with both hands and then doing the actual drilling by rotating the auger. However, manual drilling is optional and it can be set back to automatic from the game settings. 

In general the VR has been improved in many ways from the interface and and user experience point of view. If you own a Vive system, this update is really worthwhile to check out.

[b][h1]NEW SPECIES[/h1][/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/cbd497ea4bc0f10b4038b06e237d224ad0a9b6db.jpg[/img]
Three new fish species are introduced. There have been so many requests about having more North American species, so we wanted to add probably two of the most famous angling fish into Ice Lakes. Largemouth and smallmouth bass are both very popular game fish and therefore deserve a place also in our game.

The surprise addition is sturgeon. Note that in real life most sturgeon species are endangered and protected and are on the brink of extinction. We do not encourage to catch them outside this game and we hope that we can spread a word of protecting this ancient species and help stopping the illegal fishing. Therefore, enjoy the this fish in our game, so you don't need to do it in real life.


[b][h1]NEW MAP - GOLD RUSH[/h1][/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/c3192c23696a0dd1c3b3cab41ccf2680e4531034.jpg[/img]
Gold Rush is the 15th map in Ice Lakes. It is located around an old abandoned gold mine where no fisherman has visited in a long time. The deeb abysses in this map are great places to catch even the biggest beasts in the game. 

[b][h1]OTHER[/h1][/b]
New competition modes, new achievements, gameplay balances, updates to  sound effects and multiplayer are just a few smaller things there are in this game. 

This has been a great update to work with and finally it is out!

notes.title: Ice Lakes VR Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/cdcb935a9103b302985b11d746b26d95ff39e0e3.jpg[/img]

This update adds a support for HTC Vive VR system. This makes Ice Lakes a really unique ice fishing experience on the home systems. Use Vive controller like a real fishing rod and roam around the beautifull landscapes like in the real life.

The game also experiences a revamp regarding the graphics and menus. All new features and content will also work in the standard version of the game except the VR specific ones.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/5a7a578e0fdbdb7059e5fae1c4a5f8e0b2d9f998.jpg[/img]
The first new map in this update is Emperor's Garden. This introduces a completely new far eastern themed environment and is also a good place to fish smelt.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/32f9b8ca88d39a06ddb9280a4c207e51fc26f6b3.jpg[/img]
Another new maps is the Ice Lakes, which is a wilderness map with beautifull waterfalls and lots of small ponds and connecting rivers where you can fish in this diverse environment.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/78b9d016dc2a2f10172d37751aa0888f4a610eb9.jpg[/img]
New fish species introduced in this update are smelt and a catfish black bullhead. Smelts are new type that can be caught from almost every map and they are found schooling little under the ice. Black bullheads on the other hand are more rare and can be found from little deeper.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/170cc1ca5656430fb821791a8a641023b390b7e2.jpg[/img]
Two new tournaments are introduced in this update, in which these new fish species and maps are put to the test. The first one concentrates on the far eastern theme and the second tournament is a series of quick competitions finally adding a shorter option for tournament players!

[h1]Other things[/h1]
Finally there are of course bug fixes, gameplay balances. Also the multiplayer reward system has been adjusted so that the reward will scale depending on how many players there are playing on the server.

[h1]Coming next[/h1]
In the next update we will introduce a fish fight mechanic that is currently in the testing. At first it might be only an option and can be turned on/off and we'll see how it goes since it is so drastic change to gameplay mechanics. More information about that later ;)

notes.title: Ice Lakes 1.5 - Midsummer Mega Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/0f8409b8c383a01c43a2b2fbf4051d78602b0d00.jpg[/img]
Midsummer parties are closing in, but in Ice Lakes winter never ends. Let's make fishing great again!

[h1]New features[/h1]
- Ice fishing cabins 
- 2 new maps 
- 3 new fish species: Bluegill, crappie and flounder 
- 2 new tournaments
- 2 new jig types: Spinners and spoons 
- 40 new jigs 
- 5 new bait types 
- 2 new characters 
- New achievements 
- Lure colors now match bait colors
- Multiplayer host can kick players by typing to game chat "/kick playernick"
- Lots of known bugs fixed 
- Balances and improvements to gameplay
- Dedicated servers (alpha release)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/3bbfa2df5a37e30e683bab8321833d52218c75eb.jpg[/img]
Fish cabins can be found from the two new maps. Players can go inside the warmth of a cabin where the freezing winds and cold weather does not distract the fisherman by freezing the hole. You don't have to worry about slush preventing the fishing. Another great thing about these cabins is that occasionally some species may find a good spot under or near them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/779cb45d188da56a75f3369af3568a28a47ebf1d.jpg[/img]
Two new maps are concentrated on environments taking their inspiration from the North American continent. Also the species you can get from these maps are more typical to that region, including the new fish species.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/b95da89a1c966056448dd2446a2c962267263064.jpg[/img]
Species from the New World are swimming to Ice Lakes. Bluegill and Black Crappie make the fishing even more diverse. Flounder on the other hand, is an interesting fellow. They can lay on the bottom from very shallow to very deep waters. Catching flounders gives a whole dimension to the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/f045a96d23ac0e415a7f28cdc44f2eb7ce3a5286.jpg[/img]
Two completely new tournaments increase the total number of tournaments to 14! New tournaments continues the theme of the North American ice fishing and concentrates on the new maps and species. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/95b584bb6f0a7998d17764c76498af15b7839338.jpg[/img]
A whole new wave of different jigs and baits are added to equipment selection. In total there are 40 new jigs and 5 new bait types. They will also introduce two completely new jig types; Spinners and spoons. Moreover the 20 new mormyshka and balanced jigs are special type of jigs that can be used in more focused way since they are at their best only for one species each.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/3f690be509deae93925df2ae48da7c4b3e7cef4b.jpg[/img]
Select one of these two new characters, the dark knights of ice fishing, and show how the fishing is done!


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11177078/7151fed4698bf3006c85ab86364a2447b261e50c.jpg[/img]
Finally there are also dozens of new achievements. Take your goal and go for it! 

[h1]DEDICATED SERVERS[/h1]
The first version of dedicated servers are released alongside with this update. However, it is still in alpha stage and has not been properly tested at this point. 

[h1]FUTURE[/h1]
What lies ahead? This update also makes a groundwork for new things to come. Dedicated servers will be improved, night mode and some new game modes are new features we are planning to release in the next updates.

notes.title: The First Details of the upcoming Mega Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! As you might have noticed in the previous patch note we are preparing a huge content update, which will be released in June.

Here are some details of the upcoming MEGA UPDATE!

- Ice fishing cabins 
- 3 new fish species: Bluegill, crappie and flounder
- 2 new maps
- 2 new jig types: Spinners and spoons
- 2 new characters
- 40 new jigs 
- 5 new bait types 
- New achievements 

And then some. Of course we are also fixing known bugs and even more improving the gameplay.

Lastly, here are couple of new screenshots from the new features.

notes.title: Ice Lakes Update
notes.notes:
Release Notes 05.05.2016
Version: 1.2

- Fixed information popup depth order in ingame store
- Disappearing rod reeling sound fixed
- Password field no longer shows the password visibly on screen
- Lowering the line now negatively affects the fishing
- Pulling up speed now depends on the weight of the fish
- Navigation mesh fixes to multiple levels, should prevent player getting stuck
- Fish no longer disappears out of the screen after pull up animation
- Free fishing time is no longer shown in server browser
- Rod bending is now done with proper spring physics
- Target depth can now be set anytime in the fishing scene
- Fishes caught in the free fishing mode are now included in statistics
- Bait is no longer removed completely when catching a fish
- AI skill levels are now stored in tournaments, increases tournament difficulty
- Changing to another new hole is now more beneficial

[Whitefish]
- Fat fin added
- Decreased the probability of getting whitefish

- Notification to go back when time is running out in competitions
- And a pile of smaller issues
